card.name: Past dates in historical narrative
card.fires_on: Digits and endings of past years or centuries (18__, 19th, 1945-56) and phrases like "back then" in history-telling text. It fires inside the date, before the narrative moves on.

modes.label: Inside a year
modes.description: A digit in the middle or end of a past year in a historical account.

modes.label: Century or 'back then'
modes.description: The ordinal ending of a century or the words marking a past time.
modes.example: at the end of the 19<<th>> century, electrical wall lamps followed.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a past-time narrative (e.g. a following year or past-tense detail) and away from words like 'today' or 'originally'.
card.plain: It lights up when a text is giving a past date or saying 'back then' in a history story.
